author: k.hoss
title: Weirdly disturbing levels, especially in 3.
content:
This app is honestly disturbing in ways that go beyond normal “dark” storytelling. Several levels revolve around repeatedly hiding to prevent the female (sometimes male too) character from being murdered or assaulted. Even when it isn’t shown on screen, it’s explicitly referenced, which makes the gameplay feel uncomfortable rather than suspenseful.

On top of that, the character design leans heavily into fatphobic and misogynistic tropes? The villains are consistently portrayed as “fat” and/or “ugly,” which feels lazy and gross in 2026. There are plenty of ways to create tension without punching down at marginalized groups.

I wouldn’t recommend this unless the developers seriously rethink the tone and character design.
